items.source: Designed for use as a base class, with the subclass invoking the beforeAccess() and afterAccess() methods at appropriate points of its workflow. Note that afterAccess should usually be called in a finally block!
items.translation: 设计用作基类，子类在其工作流的适当点调用beforeAccess()和afterAccess()方法。请注意，afterAccess通常应在finally块中调用！
此支持类的默认并发限制为 UNBOUNDED_CONCURRENCY。子类可以覆盖此默认值；请检查您所使用的具体类的 javadoc。

items.source:
Setting the limit to this value permits any number of concurrent
invocations: that is, concurrency will not be throttled.
items.translation: 将此值设置为该限制允许任意数量的并发调用：即不会进行并发节流。

items.source: Setting the limit to this value prevents all invocations.
items.translation: 将此限制设置为该值将阻止所有调用。

items.source:
In principle, this limit can be changed at runtime,
although it is generally designed as a config time setting.
items.translation: 原则上，此限制可以在运行时更改，尽管它通常被设计为配置时设置。

items.source:
NOTE: Do not switch between -1 and any concrete limit at runtime,
as this will lead to inconsistent concurrency counts: A limit
of -1 effectively turns off concurrency counting completely.
items.translation: 注意：运行时不要在 -1 和任何具体限制值之间切换，因为这会导致不一致的并发计数：-1 的限制实际上会完全关闭并发计数。

items.source: This implementation applies the concurrency throttle.
items.translation: 此实现应用了并发节流。

items.source: Triggered by beforeAccess() when the concurrency limit has been reached.
items.translation: 由beforeAccess()触发，当并发限制达到时。

items.source: Triggered by beforeAccess() when the concurrency limit has been reached. The default implementation blocks until the concurrency count allows for entering.
items.translation: 由beforeAccess()触发，当达到并发限制时。默认实现会阻塞，直到并发计数允许进入为止。

items.source: Transient to optimize serialization.
items.translation: 瞬态以优化序列化。

items.source: To be invoked after the main execution logic of concrete subclasses.
items.translation: 要在具体子类的主体执行逻辑之后调用。

items.source: Return the maximum number of concurrent access attempts allowed.
items.translation: 返回允许的最大并发访问尝试次数。

items.source: Return whether this throttle is currently active.
items.translation: 返回当前该节流器是否处于激活状态。

items.source:
Concurrency limit which signals that concurrency throttling has been
disabled: 0.
items.translation: 并发限制为 0，表示已禁用并发节流。

items.source: Concurrency limit which signals unbounded concurrency: -1.
items.translation: 表示无限制并发的并发限制：-1。

items.source: To be invoked before the main execution logic of concrete subclasses.
items.translation: 要在具体子类的主体执行逻辑之前调用。

items.source: Set the maximum number of concurrent access attempts allowed.
items.translation: 设置允许的最大并发访问尝试次数。

items.source: true if the concurrency limit for this instance is active
items.translation: true 表示此实例的并发限制已生效。
